svg.title: Two sufficient routes to an exact finite whole-tunnel partition
svg.desc: A selected finite square can be completed by a positive residual trace certificate or by a small cut and overlap certificate. The unrestricted input from amenability remains unproved. Boxes and arrows encode proof steps, not traces or geometry.

g.text: Two sufficient routes to a finite whole-tunnel partition
Actual finite-index II₁ inclusion; finite targets Y; ε > 0
76.4: selected whole-tunnel blocks and physical residual f
P₀, Q₀; old physical supports are orthogonal; target error < ε/2
Each selected block has its complete actual finite whole-tunnel pair
if the positive certificate is supplied
if the small-cost certificate is supplied
Route A: exact positive residual certificate
τ(f) ∈ Γ₊ ⇔ finite positive trace certificate [FP.9]
j ≥ m; z ∈ Z^(s_j); ωⱼ·z = 0; vⱼ+z ≥ 0
All-trace σ(vⱼ+z) > 0 suffices [FP.10]; no upper test
Route B: small cut / ordered overlap certificate
Δⱼ ≤ ℰⱼ ≤ qΔⱼ [FP.12]
R = max(1, max of target norms); overlap is ordered
FP.3: split ranks into finitely many bounded vectors
FP.5–FP.7: choose physical residual cells fₐ ≤ f
and place each in its own actual finite tunnel.
Old whole-stage blocks stay fixed; P₀ ⊂ P*.
Canonical certificate pieces need not be orthogonal.
80.3–80.4: optimal cuts remove total trace Δⱼ
Enlarge the physical residual by the removed pieces.
Complement ranks certify that new residual exactly.
Extra target error ≤ (1+√2)‖y‖√Δⱼ.
Cut old supports may change; targets remain fixed.
Finite full support partition: sum of physical supports = 1
Every cell has its complete supported actual whole-tunnel pair
E_N E_{P_*} = E_{P_*} E_N = E_{Q_*}; target error < ε [FP.6–FP.7 / FP.16]
Remaining unrestricted input: not proved here
Amenability must supply a positive certificate, a sufficiently cheap actual selection,
or another complete construction of the original finite partition [FP.0–FP.1].
Positions, areas and colors carry no trace, rank or geometric measurement.
